mechanism_claims.claim_text: KCM21 rapidly kills both tested bacterial strains, with faster killing against C. michiganensis subsp. michiganensis than P. syringae pv. tomato DC3000 in phosphate-buffer kinetics.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: KCM21 against C. michiganensis subsp. michiganensis KACC 20122 and P. syringae pv. tomato DC3000

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=7:Kinetics of bactericidal activity of KCM21; Fig. 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: Kinetic MBC values support rapid killing but do not identify a unique molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Divalent cations, especially Ca2+, antagonize KCM21 activity more strongly against the Gram-negative P. syringae pv. tomato DC3000 strain than against the Gram-positive C. michiganensis strain.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: condition-dependent cation effects on KCM21 activity

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:Results and Discussion; Fig. 1 and Fig. 2

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper frames outer membrane/LPS involvement as interpretation from cation sensitivity, not a direct binding assay.
